Subject: Next steps & technical deep dive  - Opal AI

Alex / Samira  - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from my side and a proposed next step:

Summary from discovery:
- Primary use case: real-time personalization in search + content generation for product pages (latency target ~150ms p50 for short responses).
- Expected throughput: ~200-300 concurrent requests during peak; bursty traffic from marketing campaigns.
- Constraints: data residency in US, encrypted at rest, SOC 2 controls are important for procurement.

Recommended next step:
- 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML/infra team and our runtime engineers to validate throughput assumptions, discuss model variants/quantization tradeoffs, and align on integration points (API vs dedicated deployment).

Proposed attendees (from our side):
- Marissa Cole (Account Executive)  - sales + timeline/contract
- Camila Reyes (Solutions Engineer)  - demo and integration patterns
- Connor O'Brien (Runtime Engineer)  - latency/throughput, deployment options
Please let us know if you want additional Redwood folks on the call (security or TAM).
Proposed time slots (all PT):
- Tue, Jun 23  - 10:00-11:30 PT
- Wed, Jun 24  - 09:00-10:30 PT or 10:00-11:30 PT
- Thu, Jun 25  - 13:00-14:30 PT
I attached a short draft agenda and example inputs to help your ML team prep. If you have a preferred slot, I'll send a calendar invite and include the agenda + pre-reads. Also, if you can share a small sample of typical input shapes (anonymized), that would help us pick model/quantization profiles to discuss.
Thanks - looking forward to continuing the conversation.
—
